title: AgentIdentity
description: AgentIdentity — the ONE shared, versioned agent-identity schema (issue #346): the single source of truth for the agent record both agent-orchestrator and shared-frontend carry. It is the UNION of the shared-frontend TeamAgent wire fields ({id, name, provider, modelTier, status, capabilities}) and the agent-orchestrator AgentProfile contract fields (version, owner, systemPromptRef, toolAllowlist, constraintSet, capabilitySet, defaultModelTier, memoryScope, guardrailPolicyRef, plus the optional role/model/transport/effort/capabilityTier/fallbackChain/canonicalLanes/weekly_spend_ceiling). Every enum is CLOSED: a status outside registered|active|paused|retired, a modelTier outside LOW|MED|HIGH|MAX, or a capability that is free text rather than a capabilityId is refused by the schema itself. The vocabularies are pinned to agent-profile.schema.json and catalog.yaml by a parity gate (registry/profiles/parity/, scripts/check-agent-identity-parity.sh): a vocabulary or field change on EITHER side fails the gate until it is reconciled here, never forked. The contract and the three drift axes are documented in docs/AGENT-IDENTITY.md.

id.description: Stable agent id (lowercase, dash-separated, e.g. orchestrator, data-agent). Both repos address an agent by this id; for an agent-orchestrator seed it must equal the seed filename stem.

name.description: Human-readable display name. shared-frontend carries a free-text name; here it is a bounded string (1..80 characters). An agent-orchestrator seed that declares no name is PROJECTED to its id (see docs/AGENT-IDENTITY.md), so the field is never absent from the identity view.

provider.description: Provider slug that carries the agent's model (lowercase, dash-separated; e.g. anthropic, deepseek, ollama). Shape-constrained so free prose cannot drift into the field; the VALUE SET is owned by the gateway provider registry and is deliberately not duplicated here. Projection: a seed's transport maps deepseek->deepseek, api->anthropic, session->anthropic, and a seed declaring no transport projects to unspecified.

modelTier.description: Dispatch tier on the flash/pro ladder. The CLOSED four-rung ladder (LOW/MED/HIGH/MAX) is the superset of the shared-frontend two-tier notion (fast/pro), so both repos validate against one vocabulary. A seed's defaultModelTier is projected here when the seed does not declare modelTier explicitly.

status.description: Agent lifecycle status. The CLOSED four-value union of agent-orchestrator (registered|active|paused|retired) and shared-frontend (active|paused|retired), so a record from either repo validates. A seed that declares no status is projected to registered.

capabilities.description: CLOSED capability list (catalog capabilityId ids). This is the field that killed the free-text capabilities drift: a capability that is not a catalog id is refused by the schema and by the parity gate, never silently accepted.

version.description: SemVer version of THIS record (X.Y.Z). A published (id, version) is immutable: once recorded in versions/manifest.yaml, editing the file that carries it is refused by the validator (sha256 mismatch).

owner.description: Accountable owner of the identity's lifecycle, expressed as namespace/team (e.g. platform/quality). Identity/RBAC consumes this as a principal/team reference.

systemPromptRef.description: Pinned reference to a versioned prompt module, format <module>/<name>@v<n> (e.g. coder/primary@v1).

role.description: Canonical CMR agent role this identity fills. Optional: a platform identity need not name a role, but when it does the id must exist in the canonical role vocabulary.

model.description: Concrete worker model for the default tier (flash or pro), separating the MODEL axis from the tier axis. Optional.

transport.description: How the model is carried: a provider API (deepseek/api) or the running CLI session. Optional; the provider projection reads it (see the provider property).

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this identity's dispatches (low/medium/high). Optional.

capabilityTier.description: Capability tier (deep/balanced/fast) chosen from dispatch complexity, distinct from the semantic model tier. Optional.

fallbackChain.description: Ordered fallback chain of canonical role ids to dispatch when this identity cannot serve the task. Optional.

canonicalLanes.description: Canonical lane ids this identity owns. Optional.

toolAllowlist.description: Closed allowlist of tool ids this identity may invoke. Any tool not in the platform tool catalog is rejected (fail closed).

constraintSet.description: Boundary constraints (deny/require rules) this identity operates under, drawn from the closed constraint catalog.

capabilitySet.description: The agent-orchestrator spelling of the closed capability set. Kept alongside capabilities so an AgentProfile seed validates unchanged; the identity projection copies it into capabilities.

defaultModelTier.description: The agent-orchestrator spelling of the default dispatch tier. Kept alongside modelTier; the identity projection copies it into modelTier.

memoryScope.description: Memory scopes this identity may read/write (user/session/repository). At least one scope is required.

guardrailPolicyRef.description: Single reference to the guardrail policy (atomic or bundle id) bound to this identity. Unknown policy ids are rejected (fail closed).

weekly_spend_ceiling.description: First-class per-identity FinOps ceiling: the maximum the platform may spend on this identity in a rolling week, in USD. Optional.

statusValue.description: CLOSED lifecycle status: the union of agent-orchestrator (registered|active|paused|retired) and shared-frontend (active|paused|retired). The superset is deliberate — both repos validate against ONE vocabulary, and neither may add a status without reconciling this enum (the parity gate fails until it is).

roleId.description: Canonical CMR agent-role vocabulary. Pinned to agent-profile.schema.json definitions.roleId by the parity gate.

workerModel.description: Concrete worker model: flash = the volume tier, pro = the reasoning tier. Pinned to agent-profile.schema.json.

transport.description: Transport that carries the model. Pinned to agent-profile.schema.json.

capabilityTier.description: Capability tier for three-tier routing. Pinned to agent-profile.schema.json.

canonicalLane.description: Canonical CMR lane vocabulary. Pinned to agent-profile.schema.json.

weeklySpendCeiling.description: Non-negative weekly spend ceiling in USD. Draft-07 treats booleans as a distinct type, so true/false fail here.

toolId.description: Closed platform tool catalog. Pinned to agent-profile.schema.json AND catalog.yaml tools by the parity gate.

capabilityId.description: Closed platform capability catalog. Pinned to agent-profile.schema.json AND catalog.yaml capabilities by the parity gate — this is the vocabulary that refuses free-text capabilities.

constraintId.description: Closed platform constraint catalog. Pinned to agent-profile.schema.json AND catalog.yaml constraints by the parity gate.

guardrailPolicyId.description: Closed guardrail-policy catalog: atomic policy ids plus named bundle ids. Pinned to agent-profile.schema.json AND catalog.yaml guardrailPolicies by the parity gate.

modelTier.description: Dispatch tier on the flash/pro ladder (LOW/MED -> flash, HIGH/MAX -> pro). Pinned to agent-profile.schema.json AND catalog.yaml tiers by the parity gate.

memoryScopeValue.description: Memory scope. Pinned to agent-profile.schema.json AND catalog.yaml memoryScopes by the parity gate.
